facts.fact: The document is the national statistics strategy ENDE 2025-2029, the third for the Sistema Estatistico Nacional, presented as the one to be implemented; it states no adoption date, so the year is the document's published date (2025).
The ENDE 2018-2021 was a national statistics strategy that ended in 2021; no successor was drawn up immediately, and some of its activities continued ad hoc until 2024.

An evaluation report of the ENDE 2018-2021 found a physical execution rate of 52.8% of 144 planned actions and 41.0% financial execution of EUR 6.973 million; the final evaluation planned for the period was not carried out. Dated by the document's published year, 2025.
